title: Blot Reader
tagline: Drip ink, press the fold, and an oracle reads your blot.
how_to: Drag on the left half to drip ink (hold still to pool it), then tap Press the fold.
description: A sheet of paper with a crease down the middle. Drip, flick and pool ink on the left half, then press the fold: the flap swings over and prints a mirrored blot. An oracle reads it aloud, and its reading depends on how much ink you used, where it sits and whether the halves touch.
spark: Ink as a Rorschach blot on folded paper.
proud_of: The slow-moving pen makes fat pools and fast flicks throw splatter, so every blot feels hand-made.
